declarations.name: original_modular_finitePart
declarations.doc: The complete modular angular finite part equals the actual grouped constant coefficient. Only the derived nonconstant cusp powers are subtracted.

declarations.name: reflected_modular_finitePart
declarations.doc: The original reflected reader has zero complete modular angular-transfer finite part. This keeps the source, onset lift, Fourier tails, compact core and actual curved boundary.

declarations.name: diagonal_modular_finitePart
declarations.doc: Diagonal physical angular transfer has zero complete modular finite part.
